prompt: Who was the Prime Minister of Canada in the year that the 1965 winner of the Best New Artist Grammy Award made their first appearance on US television?
answer: The Beatles won the 1965 Grammy for Best New Artist and made their first U.S. television appearance in **1964**. Canada’s prime minister that year was **Lester B. Pearson**.
